subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Zhe, the young adult man in <Picture 1>: tousled dark blue-grey hair, cream jacket, grey T-shirt, dark-grey trousers, black-and-white sneakers.
<Subject 2> is Vivian, the young adult woman in <Picture 2>: long wavy lavender hair, pointed ears, black-and-purple headpiece, white blouse, purple bow tie, black pleated skirt, black over-knee socks and loafers.
<Subject 3> is the café exterior in <Picture 3>: glass frontage, outward-open door and flat paving; inside, window seats lie left and the counter deeper right. The door leaf and planters occupy the right side.
<Subject 4> is the two takeaway cups from <Picture 4>: cream paper, tan sleeves, dark-brown lids; both contain latte and are capped.

<Audio 2> supplies voice timbre for <Subject 2> (S1).

detailed_description:
Naturalistic cinematic comedy with daytime light and gentle tree shadows.
[Shot 1] A five-second medium-wide two-shot from the outside pedestrian area, diagonally toward the open doorway and glazing; only entrance space shows inside. <Subject 1> has stepped outside and stops, holding one cup of <Subject 4> in each hand. <Subject 2> stands beside the doorway, hands on hips, staring at him. He notices her and looks at her face. Using <Audio 2> timbre, <Subject 2> (S1) deliberately imitates his flattering delivery with obvious sarcasm, <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 你的衣服很好看。</d> Allow two seconds for their reactions.
At 00:05.000, cut to [Shot 2] a three-second medium shot toward <Subject 1> from her side, with the open doorway and entrance floor behind. Both cups remain in his hands. Using <Audio 1> timbre, <Subject 1> (S2) explains with embarrassed haste, <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 只是普通朋友。</d> Hold his expectant pause for one second.
At 00:08.000, cut to [Shot 3] a seven-second continuous wide shot from the side of the flat paving left of the doorway, diagonally toward the glass storefront. Profiles and ground stay visible. In the first four seconds, <Subject 2> frees her right hand, steps forward and punches his left cheek with her right fist. At contact his head and shoulders tip back; he instantly falls with exaggerated comic movement. As he falls, both hands open; the capped cups drop to his sides, one each, and stop. Show contact, collapse and cup landing continuously, with physical impact sounds only. She retracts her fist and looks down. Using <Audio 2> timbre, <Subject 2> (S1) says jealously and firmly, <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 普通朋友也不行。</d> Hold the final second: he lies between the cups; she stands over him; the door stays open.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet street ambience, footsteps, comic punch impact, body landing and two cup impacts.
